title: Cell apoptosis inhibitor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a cell apoptosis inhibitor, a preparation method and application thereof. Specifically, the invention provides a compound, or pharmaceutically acceptable salt, hydrate or solvate thereof, wherein the compound is shown as a formula I. The invention also provides methods for preparing the compounds and pharmaceutical compositions containing them or their use in the treatment or prevention of diseases or conditions associated with cellular apoptosis and/or human receptor interacting protein 1 kinase (RIPK 1).

title: Condensed-cyclic compound, preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a fused ring compound, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the structure of the fused ring compound is shown as a formula I: among which, Or X 1 、X 2 、X 3 、X 4 、X 5 、X 6 、Y、L、L 1 、L 2 、A、Z、E、G、R 1 、R 2 、R 3 The definition of (2) is as described in the specification. The fused ring compound has high-efficiency and high-selectivity inhibition effect on the epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER 2), and can be used for treating related diseases which are induced by HER2 abnormality, in particular to the treatment of cancer diseases.

title: Ma Dexin derivative compounds, compositions and uses thereof for the treatment of cancer
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of medicine, in particular cancer therapy. More particularly, the present invention relates to novel compounds which are generally used as medicaments. In particular, the invention relates to the use of these novel compounds for increasing the presentation, typically the production and presentation, of an antigen of advanced translational product (PTP) origin by cells, in particular cancer cells, or for altering the immune peptide group in a subject and for inducing or stimulating an immune response in said subject. The disclosure also relates to the use of such compounds, in particular for preparing a pharmaceutical composition and/or allowing or improving the efficiency of a therapy in a subject in need thereof. Also disclosed are methods for treating a disease, particularly cancer, preventing or treating metastasis and/or recurrence of cancer in a subject. Furthermore, the invention provides kits suitable for use in preparing a composition according to the invention and/or for performing the methods described herein.

title: Pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating cancer
abstract: An object of the present invention is to reveal association of macrophages with the development/progression of a cancer, and to provide a novel pharmaceutical composition for the prevention or treatment of a cancer. The present invention provides a pharmaceutical composition for the prevention or treatment of a cancer; a composition for killing fibroblasts locating adjacent to a tumor tissue; a composition for promoting infiltration of cytotoxic T cells into a tumor tissue; a composition for suppressing the expression of a gene(s) in fibroblasts, which gene(s) suppress(es) infiltration of cytotoxic T cells into a tumor; a composition for promoting the growth of cytotoxic T cells; a composition for enhancing the cytotoxic activity of cytotoxic T cells; and a composition for enhancing the expression of a gene(s) associated with the cytotoxicity of cytotoxic T cells; containing, as an effective component, a substance having an ability to kill CD206-positive M2 macrophages.

title: Compounds for treating proliferative diseases
abstract: The present disclosure provides compounds of Formula (I): (I). The compounds described herein may be useful in treating and/or preventing proliferative diseases (e.g., cancer). Also provided in the present disclosure are pharmaceutical compositions, kits, methods, and uses including or using a compound described herein.

title: Heating device and control method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a heating device and a control method thereof, wherein the heating device comprises: the air suction and blowing assembly is used for enabling the substrate to be suspended on the heating plate and comprises a plurality of air suction holes, a plurality of air blowing holes, an air suction pipeline and an air blowing pipeline; the air blowing component is connected with the air blowing pipeline; the air blowing component is used for introducing air with set temperature into the air blowing pipeline; at least one temperature sensor for detecting a temperature of a gas within the process chamber; and the temperature regulator is used for regulating the temperature of the gas introduced into the gas blowing part according to the temperature detected by the temperature sensor so as to keep the temperature in the process chamber constant. The heating device and the control method thereof can improve the heating effect and the product yield.

title: Energy-saving equipment
abstract: The utility model provides energy-saving equipment, which comprises an energy-saving box, wherein two supporting plates are arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the energy-saving box, ventilation grooves are formed in the two supporting plates, a water tank is arranged at the top of the two supporting plates, a water level sensor is arranged at the corner of the inner wall of the water tank, a ventilation hole is formed in the top of the water tank, and a transmission mechanism is communicated with the top of the energy-saving box in a sealing manner: when gas enters the energy-saving box, the gas firstly contacts the bottom of the water tank, the water tank is heated at high temperature, then the water tank is heated to be hot water, then the gas enters the top of the inner wall of the energy-saving box through the ventilation groove formed in the supporting plate, and enters the air delivery channel through the filter screen, and when the gas flows back from the air delivery channel, the power generation fan can be driven to rotate, then the power generated by the power generation fan is converted into electric power, the gas flows back to the boiler through the first connector for secondary use, and the utilization rate is improved.

title: Air conditioning system
abstract: The utility model provides an air conditioning system which comprises a refrigerant circulation loop and a liquid storage tank, wherein the refrigerant circulation loop is formed by connecting a compressor, a four-way valve, an outdoor heat exchanger, an indoor heat exchanger and a gas-liquid separator through pipelines, the four-way valve is provided with a first port, a second port, a third port and a fourth port, the first port is connected to an exhaust port of the compressor, the second port is connected to the outdoor heat exchanger, the third port is connected to the indoor heat exchanger, the fourth port is connected to an inlet of the gas-liquid separator, the liquid storage tank is connected between the third port and the indoor heat exchanger through a first control valve and a second control valve respectively, and the liquid storage tank is also connected to an inlet of the gas-liquid separator through a third control valve. According to the utility model, the functions of refrigerant adjustment and refrigerant transfer are realized by simply connecting the single liquid storage tank with the parts of the air conditioning system and the pipelines by adding a proper number of control valves, thereby obviously simplifying the pipeline structure, reducing the cost and improving the utilization rate of the product space.

title: Fuel supply unit device
abstract: The invention discloses a fuel supply unit device which comprises an electric heater, an automatic backflushing filter, a plate cooler, a viscometer, a supply pump, an expansion tank, a mixing tank, a flowmeter, a booster pump, a duplex filter, an electric control system, a bypass, a steam heater and a pressure control system. According to the invention, the fuel is heated to achieve better fluidity and combustibility, so that the heat value of the fuel is improved, the exhaust emission is reduced, the utilization rate of the fuel is improved, and the operation cost is reduced. Meanwhile, the heater can also prevent the fuel from freezing in a low-temperature environment, and ensure the normal operation of a fuel system. The invention has the advantages of high environmental protection degree, good reliability, continuous production and the like.

title: Temperature-controllable double-step cooling and dry distillation device and using method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a temperature-controllable double-step cooling and dry distillation device and a using method thereof, and the device comprises a boiler, a boiler cover, a first pipeline, a first collecting tank, a second pipeline, a condensing tank, a second collecting tank, a smoke extractor and a frame, wherein the boiler is connected with the boiler cover through bolts, an electric furnace tray and a material basket are installed in the boiler, a thermometer is fixedly installed on the wall of the boiler, one end of the first pipeline penetrates through the boiler cover to be communicated with the boiler, the other end of the first pipeline is communicated with the first collecting tank, the first collecting tank is communicated with one end of the condensing tank through the second pipeline, the other end of the condensing tank is communicated with the second collecting tank through a third pipeline, and the second collecting tank is communicated with the smoke extractor through a fourth pipeline. The electric furnace plate with the adjustable heating temperature heats materials, the temperature in the furnace can be heated to 800 ℃, dry distillation can be carried out on different materials, the rotating speeds of a smoke extractor and a cooling fan are adjusted, zero emission of waste gas can be realized, and distillate generated by the dry distillation of a radiator and a cooling tank is cooled twice, so that the distillate generated by the dry distillation is cooled as far as possible to form dry distillation liquid.

title: Fastening device for processing machine tool
abstract: The invention discloses a fastening device for a processing machine tool, which comprises a floating assembly, a clamping assembly and a cylinder assembly, wherein the floating assembly comprises an installation frame, a fixed plate arranged on the installation frame, a first optical axis arranged between the installation frame and the fixed plate and a vertical spring sleeved outside the first optical axis; the clamping assembly is arranged on the mounting frame and comprises a pressing plate, a left clamping seat and a right clamping plate, wherein the left clamping seat and the right clamping plate are arranged on two sides of the pressing plate; the air cylinder assembly comprises an air cylinder mounting seat, an air cylinder arranged on the air cylinder mounting seat and an air cylinder connecting seat connected with the air cylinder; the fastening device provided by the invention provides a functional taking and placing fastening device which is matched with a robot or a three-coordinate device for use, the gripper has the advantages of up-and-down floating, workpiece pressing and left-and-right floating, a double-cylinder floating device is adopted for clamping, certain deviation can be allowed during gripping, a machining machine tool can be quickly modified through connecting devices such as a hanging ring, and the fastening device has high universality under different modification conditions.

title: Reinforcing steel bar conveying device
abstract: The invention discloses a steel bar conveying device which comprises a frame, a receiving mechanism, a turnover mechanism and a conveying mechanism, wherein the frame is horizontally arranged left and right; the material receiving mechanism comprises support columns, connecting columns, material receiving assemblies and guide plates, wherein each two support columns are vertically arranged on the front side and the rear side of the top surface of the frame in a group, and a plurality of groups are arranged at intervals along the left-right horizontal direction; the two connecting columns are arranged in the left-right horizontal direction, and the bottom surfaces of the two connecting columns are fixedly connected with the top surfaces of the supporting columns on the front side and the rear side of the top of the frame respectively; the material receiving components are respectively arranged on the connecting columns through the turnover mechanisms; the guide plates are vertically arranged on one side of each group of support columns, one side of each guide plate is inclined downwards, and the other side of each guide plate is arranged at intervals to form a blanking channel; the conveying mechanism is arranged in the middle of the top surface of the frame. The invention has high degree of automation, time and labor saving, labor cost saving, production efficiency improvement and good application prospect.

title: Automobile generator end cover machining, clamping and positioning device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of machining tools and discloses an automobile generator end cover machining clamping and positioning device which comprises a machining table, wherein a rotating table is arranged on the machining table, a rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the center of the bottom of the rotating table, a first limiting mechanism for fixing a center hole of an end cover is arranged in the rotating shaft, a round hole for extending out of the first limiting mechanism is formed in the upper surface of the rotating table, a supporting seat is fixedly connected to one side of the machining table, a lifting seat is slidably connected to the supporting seat in the vertical direction, a second limiting mechanism for fixing an end cover mounting lug is arranged on the lifting seat, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to one side of the lifting seat in the vertical direction, a third limiting mechanism for clamping and fixing two side edges of the end cover is arranged at the bottom of the connecting rod, and a control mechanism for controlling the third limiting mechanism to turn over 180 DEG is arranged on the supporting seat. The invention can restrict the vibration generated by the end cover during processing, prevent the end cover from moving upwards during the rotation processing of the end cover, ensure the clamping stability and ensure the processing effect.

title: Mechanical part clamping device for mechanical engineering
abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical accessory clamping device for mechanical engineering, and belongs to the technical field of clamping. A mechanical part clamping device for mechanical engineering comprises a base, wherein the outer wall of the base is fixedly connected with a box body, a driving mechanism and a gas collecting mechanism are arranged in the box body, the inner wall of the box body is fixedly connected with a partition plate and a stabilizer bar, a first avoidance groove is formed in the box body, a first screw rod and a second screw rod are rotationally connected to the box body, a first belt wheel and a second bevel gear are fixedly connected to the first screw rod, a second belt wheel and a third bevel gear are fixedly connected to the second screw rod, fixing blocks are in threaded connection with the first screw rod and the second screw rod, the fixing blocks are connected to the stabilizer bar in a sliding mode, the thread directions of the first screw rod and the second screw rod are opposite, and a clamping mechanism is arranged at the top of each fixing block; the automatic clamping device is simple to operate, can automatically clamp the accessories, can clean the accessories in the clamping and loosening processes, greatly saves labor and time, and improves production efficiency.

title: Ship electrical equipment installation fixing device
abstract: The invention discloses a ship electrical equipment installation fixing device, and relates to the field of equipment installation. The invention comprises a support frame and electrical equipment, wherein the support frame is provided with a moving mechanism, a fixing mechanism and a fastening mechanism, and the moving mechanism comprises a driving assembly and a limiting assembly; the driving assembly comprises a moving plate arranged on the inner wall of a supporting frame, a sliding groove is formed in the supporting frame, sliding rails are fixedly connected to the front side and the rear side of the moving plate, the inner wall of the sliding groove is in sliding connection with the sliding rails, pulleys are fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the moving plate, a threaded rod penetrates through the supporting frame in a rotating mode, the threaded rod extends to the inner portion of the moving plate in a sliding mode, an inner thread block is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the moving plate, and threads of the threaded rod penetrate through the inner thread block. By arranging the fixing mechanism, the invention effectively prevents loosening and deviation possibly occurring in the transportation of the ship and further improves the clamping reliability.

title: Display device
abstract: The application provides a display device, which comprises a display substrate, a main circuit board, a first connecting circuit board and a second connecting circuit board. The display substrate includes a base layer, an insulating layer, a first signal line, a second signal line, a first pad, and a second pad, wherein the insulating layer is on the base layer, the first signal line is on the base layer, the second signal line is on the base layer, the first pad is exposed from the insulating layer and connected to the first signal line, and the second pad is connected to a side surface of the second signal line and disposed on a side surface and a bottom surface of the base layer. The first connection circuit board electrically connects the first pad and the main circuit board, and the second connection circuit board electrically connects the second pad and the main circuit board.

title: Electronic device and method for manufacturing electronic device
abstract: An electronic device includes a substrate having a recessed portion on a first surface; a first superconducting wiring having a portion in contact with the first surface; a second superconducting wiring intersecting the first superconducting wiring in a plan view above the recessed portion and having a portion in contact with the first surface; an insulating film provided between the first superconducting wiring and the second superconducting wiring; and a first support member provided in the recessed portion and supporting at least one of the first superconducting wiring or the second superconducting wiring, wherein a hollow portion is formed between a region where the first superconducting wiring and the second superconducting wiring intersect in a plan view and a bottom surface of the recessed portion.

title: Semiconductor Device
abstract: A semiconductor device according to some embodiments of the concept of the present invention includes: a substrate including an active pattern; a first source/drain pattern and a second source/drain pattern overlapping the active pattern; a separation insulating film between the first source/drain pattern and the second source/drain pattern; and a first gate electrode and a second gate electrode spaced apart from each other with the separation insulating film interposed therebetween. The level of the upper side of the isolation insulating layer highs than the level of the upper side of the level of the upper side of the first gate electrode and the second gate electrode.

title: Electronic device with fine pitch and thick conductors and method of making the same
abstract: The invention provides an electronic device and its manufacturing method. The electronic device includes a first conductive component, which includes a first seed layer, a first conductive layer, a first conductive thickening layer, and a first insulating layer. The first seed layer has a plurality of first seed blocks. The first conductive layer has a plurality of first conductive blocks. Each of the first conductive blocks is disposed on a top surface of the first seed block, respectively. The first conductive thickening layer has a plurality of first conductive thickened blocks, which covers one side surface of each first seed block and one side surface of each first conductive block respectively. The first insulating layer covers the first seed layer, the first conductive layer, and the first conductive thickening layer.

title: Display apparatus, display module, and electronic device
abstract: A novel display apparatus that is highly convenient, useful, or reliable is provided. The display apparatus includes a first light-emitting device including a first electrode, a first layer, a first unit, and a second electrode and a second light-emitting device including a third electrode, a second layer, a second unit, and a fourth electrode. The first unit is between the first electrode and the second electrode and includes a first light-emitting material. The first layer is between the first unit and the first electrode and is in contact with the first electrode. The third electrode is adjacent to the first electrode. A first gap is between the third electrode and the first electrode. The second unit is between the third electrode and the fourth electrode and includes a second light-emitting material. The second layer is between the second unit and the third electrode and is in contact with the third electrode. The first layer and the second layer use a material having a first spin density and a material having a second spin density higher than the first spin density, respectively, each observed with an electron spin resonance (ESR) spectrometer when the material is in a film state.

title: Thermoplastic composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a thermoplastic composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the thermoplastic composite material comprises a surface layer material and a framework material; the surface layer material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 30-50 parts of high-fluidity polypropylene resin, 45-50 parts of untwisted continuous glass fiber, 1-8 parts of compatilizer, 0.5-1 part of lubricant, 1-2 parts of antioxidant, 1-8 parts of highlight improver and 1-2 parts of carbon black; the framework material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 20-35 parts of medium-high fluidity polypropylene resin, 50-70 parts of untwisted continuous glass fiber, 1-8 parts of compatilizer, 0.5-1 part of lubricant, 1-2 parts of antioxidant, 1-12 parts of low warpage improver and 1-2 parts of carbon black. The thermoplastic composite material provided by the invention has good mechanical properties, high surface gloss, high strength, low warpage and high temperature resistance, meets the requirements of automobile engine hood cover materials, and realizes the light weight of automobiles.

title: Composite membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a composite membrane, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composite membrane at least comprises a substrate layer, a coating layer and a coating layer, wherein the substrate layer is made of polyolefin, the coating layer is arranged on one side of the substrate layer, the material of the coating layer comprises elastomer and nano particles, and the median pore diameter in the coating layer is smaller than that in the substrate layer. The composite film, the preparation method and the application thereof can ensure that the garment fabric has excellent moisture permeability and water resistance, thereby improving the comfort and durability of the garment fabric.

title: Adhesive, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an adhesive, a preparation method and application thereof. The adhesive consists of a component A, a component B and a component C, wherein the component A comprises 5-15 parts of multifunctional epoxy resin, 3-10 parts of bio-based modified epoxy resin, 0.5-2.5 parts of environment-friendly reactive diluent, 0.2-0.6 part of silane coupling agent, 0.6-2.4 parts of thixotropic agent, the component B comprises 2-6 parts of amine curing agent, 1.5-4 parts of bio-based phenolic amine curing agent, 0.5-2 parts of accelerator, 40-60 parts of high-strength high-modulus inert filler and 0.2-0.4 part of environment-friendly pigment, the component C comprises 10-30 parts of surface active filler, and A, B, C parts of independent package and are mixed according to the weight ratio of 1:3:1 for use during construction. The adhesive provided by the invention can realize the cooperative unification of the low-temperature construction performance and the normal-temperature high-strength performance, and can give consideration to the bonding performance, the rheological performance and the high-strength characteristic under the normal-temperature and low-temperature conditions.

title: Resin composition, composite adhesive film, copper-clad plate and preparation and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a resin composition, which comprises thermosetting polyphenyl ether and modified filler, wherein the thermosetting polyphenyl ether is obtained by carrying out redistribution reaction and hydroxyl-terminated acrylation modification on thermoplastic polyphenyl ether, and the modified filler is obtained by carrying out surface modification on inorganic powder by adopting a double bond-containing silane coupling agent. The invention also discloses a composite adhesive film comprising the resin composition, a polyphenyl ether-based copper-clad plate and application thereof. The invention greatly improves the compatibility between the interfaces of the composite materials, improves the uniformity of the filler in the matrix, and the obtained product has excellent dielectric property and flexibility and good peel strength.

title: Resin composition
abstract: The invention provides a resin composition which can bring a cured product exhibiting good dielectric properties and having excellent adhesion strength with a conductor layer after being exposed to a high-temperature and high-humidity environment, a resin sheet using the resin composition, a cured product of the resin composition, a circuit board comprising the cured product, and a semiconductor device comprising the circuit board. A resin composition comprising (A) an epoxy resin, (B) an active ester-based curing agent, and (C) a compound containing a structural unit represented by the formula (C1) and a terminal group represented by the formula (C1).

title: Protective device for machining mechanical equipment
abstract: The utility model relates to a protective device for machining mechanical equipment, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein a movable wheel is arranged at the bottom end of the supporting plate, a lifting groove is formed in the supporting plate, a lifting plate is arranged in the lifting groove in a lifting adjustable manner, a lifting adjusting structure is arranged between the lifting plate and the supporting plate, an observation window is arranged on the lifting plate, a collecting box is arranged below the inner side wall of the supporting plate, a discharging pipe is arranged at the bottom end of the collecting box in an outward extending manner, a spiral discharging shaft is arranged in the collecting box through a bearing and matched with the discharging pipe, a driving piece is arranged on the collecting box in a transmission connection with the spiral discharging shaft, an electromagnet is arranged on the inner wall of the supporting plate in a matched manner, and the electromagnet is connected with a power supply structure.

title: Supporting device for compressor installation
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of compressor support devices and discloses a supporting device for installing a compressor, which comprises a fixed plate, wherein the tops of the left end and the right end of the fixed plate are respectively and rotatably connected with a connecting plate, the left end and the right end of the bottom end of the fixed plate are respectively and fixedly connected with a rotating plate, the opposite end of the rotating plate is rotatably connected with a loading plate, the rear end of the inner wall of the loading plate is fixedly connected with a heat dissipation assembly, the left side and the right side of the loading plate are respectively and fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the inner wall of the right supporting plate is rotatably connected with a first screw rod, the inner wall of the right supporting plate is fixedly connected with a first sliding rod, and the top of the front end of the fixed plate is fixedly connected with a fixed pipe. In the utility model, the inclination angle of the compressor can be conveniently changed, the compressor can be parallel to the ground, stable support is provided, vibration and shaking of the compressor during operation can be reduced, heat can be conveniently and freely emitted to the surrounding environment, and adverse effects of heat accumulation on the performance and service life of the compressor are reduced.

title: Composite pipe sealing device
abstract: The utility model relates to a sealing device, in particular to a composite pipe sealing device. The utility model provides a compound pipe sealing device for automatically conveying compound pipes. The utility model provides a composite pipe sealing device which comprises a support frame, a second guide rail, a sliding block, a support disc, a heating block and an electric push rod, wherein the second guide rail is fixedly connected to the rear side of the support frame, the sliding block is arranged on the second guide rail in a sliding mode, the support disc is fixedly connected to the top of the sliding block, the heating block is installed in the support disc, the electric push rod is installed on the rear side of the second guide rail, and a movable rod of the electric push rod is connected with the support disc. The first conveying wheel rotates and is matched with the second conveying wheel in an auxiliary mode through starting the motor to convey the composite pipe backwards, and therefore the composite pipe and the heating block are guaranteed to be in the same level.

title: Safety auxiliary device
abstract: The utility model discloses a safety auxiliary device, which comprises a fixed plate; the front surface of the fixing plate is rotatably provided with an extension mechanism, the front surface of the extension mechanism is fixedly provided with a support frame, one end of the inner wall of the support frame is fixedly provided with an anti-falling mechanism, the inside of the support frame is rotatably provided with a winding mechanism, and the outer side of the winding mechanism is wound with a safety rope main body; the extending mechanism comprises a bidirectional screw rod, a sleeve, a connecting rod and a connecting seat; according to the utility model, the bidirectional screw, the sleeve, the connecting rods and the connecting seat are matched for use, the sleeve can be driven to move by the rotation of the bidirectional screw, when the opening and closing angles of the two groups of connecting rods on the front of the sleeve are maximum, the supporting frame can be positioned on the front of the fixed plate, the device is stored, the occupied space is reduced, and when the opening and closing angles of the two groups of connecting rods on the front of the sleeve are reduced, one end of each connecting rod can be driven to drive the supporting frame to extend out for use, so that the device is beneficial to personnel.

title: Stirring device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of stirring, in particular to a stirring device which comprises a rotating shaft, wherein the rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the top of a box body through a driving motor, the rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the output end of the driving motor, the other end of the rotating shaft is connected to the bottom of the box body through a bearing seat, a limiting seat is coaxially and fixedly connected to one side, close to the bottom of the box body, of the rotating shaft, two arc-shaped connecting plates are connected to the outer portion of the rotating shaft in the box body, a plurality of leakage plates are vertically connected to the outer portions of the arc-shaped connecting plates, the leakage plates are vertically connected with sliding plates through the connecting plates, sliding grooves are formed in corresponding positions of the outer portions of the arc-shaped connecting plates, a fixing cover is in threaded connection with the rotating shaft, and an annular groove is coaxially formed in the bottom of the fixing cover. The utility model can separate the fixed cover from the top of the sliding plate by rotating the fixed cover, and can carry out maintenance and replacement by adjusting the bolt arranged on the fixed plate, the structure is simple, the operation is easy, and the arranged bushing plate can fully stir the raw materials and water in the bushing plate.

title: Porous silicon material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a porous silicon material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Melt mixing a silicon source and a lithium source to obtain a melt mixture; (2) Carrying out lithium removal on the molten mixture to obtain a lithium removal product; (3) And carrying out heat treatment on the lithium removal product to obtain the porous silicon material. The invention provides a preparation method with low cost, simple process and low energy consumption, and the formed silicon nano-sheets can be radially arranged in honeycomb shape in all directions of particles through lithium attachment and lithium removal to form a controllable isotropic channelized porous silicon structure. The porous silicon material prepared based on the method not only can adapt to the volume change of silicon, but also can obviously promote the rapid transmission of lithium ions, so that the material utilization and capacity exertion are not limited by particle orientation, and the porous silicon material has high surface capacity, high rate performance and excellent cycling stability, has good industrial application prospect, and can realize large-scale production.

title: Modified hydrogel adsorbent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The present disclosure provides a modified hydrogel adsorbent, a preparation method and applications thereof, the preparation method comprising the steps of: (1) Mixing a first polymer solution with an acid solution to obtain a solution A, mixing a second polymer, a cross-linking agent and a solvent to obtain a solution B, mixing the solution A and the solution B to obtain a mixed solution, adding a lithium ion sieve to obtain a pre-polymerized solution, and carrying out freezing treatment after reaction to obtain a hydrogel adsorbent; (2) And mixing the linear polymer monomer and the initiator to obtain a modified precursor solution, mixing the hydrogel adsorbent and the modified precursor solution, and carrying out light reaction to obtain the modified hydrogel adsorbent. The method has the advantages that the adsorbent/ion sieve is wrapped in the hydrogel, the hydrogel adsorbent with good mechanical stability is prepared, the impurity ion level in the adsorbent is constant, the lithium extraction method for concentrating brine by utilizing illumination can be realized, lithium is extracted while concentration is carried out, and byproduct salt is obtained, and no additional concentration step is needed.

title: Preparation method of functional composite diaphragm
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a functional composite diaphragm, and relates to the technical field of hydrogen production by water electrolysis. The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing a polymer with a solvent, heating and dispersing to prepare a uniform polymer solution, mixing zirconia and a coupling agent with the solvent, conducting ultrasonic dispersion to obtain an inorganic material dispersion liquid containing the coupling agent, adding the dispersion liquid into the polymer solution under the stirring condition, continuously stirring to obtain a uniform film casting solution, forming a base film, coating the film casting solution on a polyphenylene sulfide supporting net, standing at room temperature, placing in an oven and drying to obtain a composite base film, and carrying out surface modification, namely sequentially immersing the composite base film in a first organic alkali solution and a second organic alkali solution, washing with the solvent after each immersion, and obtaining the functional composite diaphragm after washing.

title: Preparation method of flexible composite hydrogel
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of composite hydrogel, which comprises the following steps: (1) dissolving acrylic acid, an oxidant, a doping modifier and N, N' -methylene bisacrylamide in deionized water, stirring and dispersing by utilizing ultrasonic waves to form a solution; (2) adding a conductive polymer monomer into the solution formed in the step (1), stirring and dispersing by utilizing ultrasonic waves to form a reaction system; (3) adding an initiator into the solution obtained in the step (1), and stirring and dissolving to form a reaction system; (4) standing the reaction system obtained in the steps (2) and (3) at the temperature of 60-80 ℃ for 6-24h to obtain a product, and (5) taking out the product obtained in the step (4), and cleaning the surface with deionized water to obtain the flexible composite hydrogel.

title: Preparation method and application of modified copper hydroxide material
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a modified copper hydroxide material, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing Cu (OH) 2 Dispersed in a solvent containing isopropyl alcohol (C) 2 Adding Nafion (perfluorosulfonic acid) into a mixed solution of PrOH, Tetrahydrofuran (THF) and multi-wall Carbon Nanotubes (CNTs) for physical mixing to obtain the modified copper hydroxide material (Cu (OH) 2 @ Nafion). Using the modified copper hydroxide material (Cu (OH) 2 @ Nafion) for catalyzing CO in a fluidized electrolytic cell 2 The reduction reaction shows higher multi-carbon product selectivity (the faradaic efficiency of ethylene reaches 44 percent) and better catalytic stability (the stable running time is up to 8000 s), and solves the problem of hydrophilicityThe copper hydroxide material can not be well utilized in the flowing electrolytic bath.

title: Monitoring method and device of shared equipment and electronic equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a monitoring method and device for shared equipment and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a plurality of signaling reported by a signaling acquisition system, wherein each signaling comprises an Internet of things card identification code and a position coordinate of a sharing device uniquely corresponding to the Internet of things card identification code at the current reporting moment; acquiring position coordinates of the target equipment at all reporting moments; judging whether at least one position coordinate in all position coordinates of the target equipment is located in a preset risk block or not; if at least one position coordinate is located in the risk block, determining a target risk type of the target equipment according to all position coordinates of the target equipment; and applying risk treatment measures corresponding to the target risk types to the target equipment. Through the scheme, the equipment identification and the position coordinate acquisition are carried out by utilizing the pre-existing Internet of things card in the Internet of things sharing equipment, so that the positioning cost is reduced, and the risk monitoring efficiency and timeliness of the sharing equipment are improved.

title: Method and device for machine monitoring, and computer program product for machine monitoring
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a device for machine monitoring and to a computer program product for machine monitoring. According to the invention, the image data captured with the aid of at least one camera and any additionally collected measurement data are time-limited using the image data captured with the aid of a trigger camera and evaluated for the presence of a trigger event such that only the relevant time range of the image data and, if applicable, measurement data has to be stored and analysed. This saves both time and hardware resources. In further advantageous embodiments of the invention, time synchronisation of different (image) data sources, a colour filter function, and/or a master-frame comparison for recognising faults are implemented.

title: Method and apparatus for outputting information
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a method and apparatus for outputting information. The method may include: acquiring point cloud data and image data collected by a vehicle during a driving process; determining a plurality of time thresholds based on a preset time threshold value range; executing following processing for each time threshold: identifying obstacles included in each point cloud frame and each image frame respectively; determining a similarity between the obstacles; determining, in response to the similarity being greater than a preset similarity threshold, whether a time interval between the point cloud frame and the image frame corresponding to two similar obstacles is less than the time threshold; and processing recognized obstacles based on a determining result, to determine the number of obstacles; and determining, based on a plurality of numbers, and outputting a target time threshold.

title: Detection method, detection system and storage medium based on artificial intelligence early warning system
abstract: The invention provides a detection method based on an artificial intelligence early warning system, which comprises the following steps: and classifying the monitored objects, and selecting corresponding artificial intelligence models according to the classified categories. And selecting a training sample, and training the selected artificial intelligence model by combining manual adjustment of the residual error overrun trigger threshold range of each measuring point. And applying the trained artificial intelligence model to the monitored object. The detection method based on the artificial intelligent early warning system can reduce the false alarm rate and the missing report rate of the early warning system, so that the early warning system can better play a role. The invention also provides a detection system and a storage medium for executing the detection method.

title: Artificial intelligence based monitoring system and monitoring method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring, and provides a monitoring system and a monitoring method based on artificial intelligence, wherein the monitoring system comprises a data acquisition unit; a data storage unit; the data processing unit is used for analyzing and processing the data through an artificial intelligence technology, acquiring image data, monitoring equipment data and shooting time data which are identified from a video, inputting multi-source information data into a machine learning model, and acquiring image data classified according to image types and/or image data classified according to monitoring equipment and/or image data ordered according to time sequence; the data matching unit is used for comparing the target image data with the label data obtained by the data processing unit, if the comparison is consistent, the matching is successful, and if the comparison is inconsistent, the matching is failed; and the data positioning unit is used for positioning all image data successfully matched in the data matching unit to acquire video data. The invention can save the time for the user to know the monitoring condition of the target area.

title: Glass tube
abstract: The invention relates to a glass tube, in particular a glass tube for the production of containers for storage of pharmaceutical compositions, a method of making it and its use. The glass tube facilitates production of pharmaceutical containers with particularly high quality. Further, the glass tube has a relative cross-sectional area deviation defined as QF max − QF min 1.5 m wherein QF max − QF min 1.5 m < k ⋅ x + t wherein QF max is the highest cross-sectional area and QF min is the lowest cross-sectional area of at least two cross-sections of the tube, wherein the cross-sections are spaced apart from each other along the length of the glass tube, and k is 0.0023 m -1 , t is less than 0.15 mm 2 /m and x is QF max + QF min 2 .

title: Five matrix ceramic pump liquid filling machine
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of filling machines, a five matrix ceramic pump filling machine is disclosed, which comprises a frame main body, five filling pumps have been installed to the upper end rear side of frame main part, Z axle drive assembly has been installed to the upper end front side of frame main part is fixed, drag chain board has been installed to the upper end rear side of Z axle drive assembly to the fixed mounting, upper end one side fixed mounting of frame main part has drag chain baffle, the lower extreme output fixedly connected with needle tubing of Z axle drive assembly, five filling tubes have been installed to the fixed mounting on the needle tubing, the horizontal part upper end of frame main part still is connected with two sets of jigs through two sets of X axle drive assembly fixedly. The utility model provides a five accurate filling of ration simultaneously of little dosage pump of five, has effectively improved filling quality and efficiency.

title: Winding device for packaging FCOB neon lamp strip
abstract: The utility model discloses a winding device for packaging an FCOB neon lamp strip, which comprises a workbench, wherein the lower end of the workbench is fixedly connected with four groups of support legs, one side of each support leg is provided with a winding mechanism, one side, close to the winding mechanism, of the interior of the workbench is provided with an auxiliary assembly, the winding mechanism comprises a first motor fixedly connected to the inner wall of the upper side of the workbench, the upper end of a rotating shaft of the first motor is fixedly connected with a tray, the upper end of the tray is fixedly connected with a circular tube, the outer sides of the circular tube are fixedly connected with two groups of limiting strips, and the outer sides of the circular tube and the two groups of limiting strips are movably sleeved with a winding drum. According to the winding device for packaging the FCOB neon lamp strip, disclosed by the utility model, the winding can be rapidly and easily performed through automatic winding, less labor force is output, the working winding efficiency is improved, and the winding of different lamp strips and modes can be completed through the use of the winding mechanism and the auxiliary assembly.

title: Realize multi-functional integrative rifle of charge-discharge
abstract: The utility model discloses a realize multi-functional integrative rifle of charge-discharge, relate to the new energy automobile field of charging, including charge-discharge rifle head module, first charging plug module, second charging plug module and domestic row of inserting module, carry out power transmission between each module through the three-phase power cord, first charging plug module is connected to charge-discharge rifle head module, one in second charging plug module and the domestic row of inserting module, charge-discharge rifle head module includes the control affirmation line, connect the affirmation line, main control chip and charge-discharge signal detection line, main control chip is connected to the control affirmation line, connect affirmation line and charge-discharge signal detection line, first charging plug module includes the signal butt joint socket, second charging plug module includes first resistance, domestic row of inserting module includes the second resistance, through signal butt joint socket, the input of different signals is realized to first resistance and second resistance, thereby realize charge-discharge control, conveniently carry out the mode switch.

title: Nationwide data communication network shutdown based on Ruifeng micro RK3588
abstract: The invention particularly relates to a shutdown of a nationwide data communication network based on a Rayleigh core micro RK 3588. The full-country data communication network shutdown based on the Rayleigh core micro RK3588 comprises a main board module which is manufactured in a full country, an interface board module comprises an indication lamp board and a network port expansion board, all components of the main board module and the interface board module adopt home brands, a power supply module comprises a double-path redundant power supply which is used for providing power for the main board module and the interface board module, a case module comprises a case body and front and rear panels which are arranged on the case body, and a software module comprises firmware and an operating system. The whole-country data communication network based on the Rayleigh core micro RK3588 is powered off, home-made devices are selected for each component of the main board and the interface board, 100% home-made of board-level components is achieved, home-made products are adopted for the power supply and the chassis, home-made operation systems are adopted for the operation systems, 100% whole-country production of the whole machine is achieved, and further complete autonomous control of key equipment of the power system is achieved.
